patterns_proposed.rule: Crossing of trailing completed-bar 20 and 60 valuation-session means; timestamp last input availability
Current completed close strictly above prior20 completed closes maximum or below minimum; current excluded from prior window

analogs_proposed.features: same declared lagged block scaled within fit region
analogs_proposed.distance: Euclidean on training-standardised features; weights frozen
analogs_proposed.admission: candidate label interval fully matured and outcome known before current cutoff
analogs_proposed.dependence: group overlapping intervals/economic entities; show effective evidence; no event-count guarantee
analogs_proposed.candidate_origin_lookback_sessions_note: Superseded: the proposed 756-session lookback is replaced by candidate_origin_window (owner, 2026-11-03).

candidate_origin_window.start: first eligible session on or after 2015-01-01 (about ten years)
candidate_origin_window.end: latest candidate whose full label interval matured and whose outcome was known before the current cutoff
candidate_origin_window.short_history: use the eligible history there is, disclose its start date and candidate count; never pad from another listing
candidate_origin_window.within_qualification_fold: candidates restricted to that fold's fit region
candidate_origin_window.source_dependency: history availability and rights per source remain data-lane gates

analogs_proposed.scope: same approved market-kind pool and return basis; across-instrument extension separately declared
analogs_proposed.tie_break: ascending distance, then most recent origin, then instrument_id
analogs_proposed.de_overlap: greedy nearest-first selection rejects candidate whose label interval overlaps a selected candidate from same economic entity; cross-entity/date dependence still reported
analogs_proposed.sparse: show descriptive cases and unknown precision; no calibrated probability claim without qualification

calibrators.fit: deterministic code from matured forecasts; base calibrator stays frozen

bounded_self_correction.actor: deterministic code; never a Claude agent or research agent
may_adjust: signal weights in the rules and model combination

bands.reading: proposed, open in SCI-D10: cumulative change against the value at the start of a rolling window, never step by step
bands.week_reading: proposed (SCI-D10): an issued probability moves at most 5 percentage points against its value at the start of any rolling 7 days
bands.weight_reading: proposed (SCI-D10): a signal's weight moves at most 10% of its value at the start of any rolling 30 days; 10% of the current weight at each step, or a calendar month, would let repeated steps or a month boundary exceed 10% a month

bounded_self_correction.rollback: automatic if scores worsen (owner); proposed: the adjusted version is scored against the unadjusted version on later matured paired forecasts

earliest_signal.1_session: about a week of matured paired forecasts
earliest_signal.3_6_12_months: 3, 6 or 12 months plus publication lag after the adjustment

rollback_detection_by_horizon.one_step_in_flight: a new overlay step for a horizon waits until the previous step has a predeclared minimum of matured paired forecasts, so 3/6/12-month horizons take at most one step per horizon length; the bands bound the worst case meanwhile

bounded_self_correction.point_in_time_rule: the overlay used at origin t is fitted only on outcomes whose outcome_known_at is at or before cutoff(t); an overlay whose fitted outcome set includes a later-known outcome is rejected for that origin (SCI-03 known_at rule)
bounded_self_correction.walk_forward_replay: walk-forward and replay evidence (SCI-05) that claims the overlay replays it point-in-time: at each replay origin the same code and bands rebuild it from outcomes known by that origin's cutoff; evidence without that replay covers only the frozen base calibrator
bounded_self_correction.promotion_and_revert: proposed, open in SCI-D10: each artefact keeps its own overlay lineage; a promoted model carries the overlay its shadow run built under the same bounded code during the trial (the one the trial scored); a reverted-to model resumes its own latest overlay version; overlays never move between artefacts
bounded_self_correction.records: append-only versioned CalibrationOverlay record; Prediction.calibrator_version names the base calibrator and overlay version; every overlay version persists overlay_provenance_fields before any Prediction may name it; its wire schema is added with MP-21/MP-24 before implementation

overlay_provenance_definitions.data_cutoff: the latest outcome_known_at in the fitted outcome set
overlay_provenance_definitions.fitted_outcomes: each fitted Outcome's record_id, revision and outcome_known_at
overlay_provenance_definitions.fitted_outcome_set_hash: sha256 of the sorted lines '<record_id>@<revision>' joined by newlines
overlay_provenance_definitions.rollback_of: the overlay version this one reverses, or null

bounded_self_correction.fit_cap: overlay updates are deterministic, not campaign fits, and do not spend the 96/192 fit caps; each is logged (proposed)
bounded_self_correction.shadow_candidates: run the same bounded code so the trial tests what would run live (proposed)
bounded_self_correction.source: docs/planning/ma-reconciliation-2026-11-02/decision-log.md: event and analog answers (bounded self-correction) and 3 Nov round item 4
bounded_self_correction.executable_proof: python3 forecasting/timing_checks.py --check policy: synthetic band, overlay-cutoff, trial-count and slip cases (timing-examples.json); not runtime evidence

counts: Two learned families are not two artefacts and not one per ticker. Scope and qualification determine artefacts.

llm_factors.route: separate Lambda route workers shared typed client SDK
llm_factors.prediction_evaluation: independent SCI-06 proper scores and ablations

regime_module_proposed.trend: trailing60valuation-session TRI return >0 up,<0 down,=0 flat
regime_module_proposed.volatility: sample standard deviation trailing20 log returns; do not annualise with fixed252 for NAV without approved schedule
regime_module_proposed.high_volatility: above80thpercentile of trailingvol20 observed within fit partition; threshold frozen for inference
regime_module_proposed.missing: no regime if required eligible observations absent
regime_module_proposed.use: descriptive stratum/feature; not probability or causal market state

event_module_proposed.initial_event_kind_note: Superseded: scheduled_earnings_release_equity_only first; replaced by all seven kinds in the first wave (owner, 2026-11-03).
event_module_proposed.event_origin: Mode-specific: prerelease uses scheduled daily origin before release; postrelease uses a subsequent eligible daily origin after release_known_at; prior-close event-study origin is retrospective description only.
event_module_proposed.features: Pre-release public schedule only if known by cutoff; public release fields only in postrelease daily mode with a later eligible origin/cutoff. Descriptive study content never qualifies predictive features.
event_module_proposed.outcome_windows_note: 5/20-session windows were proposed for earnings; each kind predeclares its own windows and comparators before its qualification campaign, and those choices consume trials.
event_module_proposed.outcomes: separate terminal total return and arithmetic benchmark excess; same currency/endpoints
event_module_proposed.confounding: display overlapping releases/market events and calendar/sector comparators; association not causation
event_module_proposed.search: event-kind/window definitions predeclared and consume trials; no post-result cohort selection

prerelease_daily_prediction.origin: ordinary daily origin before the release; its frozen cutoff must precede release_known_at and all schedule information must be known by cutoff
prerelease_daily_prediction.target: 5/20-session target starts at this daily origin; release content excluded
prerelease_daily_prediction.qualification: separate purged matched-date incremental evidence required

postrelease_daily_prediction.origin: next eligible ordinary daily valuation origin strictly after release_known_at; wait for its normal frozen cutoff and source eligibility
postrelease_daily_prediction.target: new task/version and 5/20-session target beginning at that later daily valuation, not the previous close or release instant
postrelease_daily_prediction.qualification: content known by later cutoff; prospective/hindsight and rights gates remain; separate incremental evidence required

retrospective_event_study.origin: last eligible completed valuation before release_known_at; explicit retrospective prior-close event study
retrospective_event_study.target: descriptive 5/20-session event-window return/excess with confounding and comparator cohorts
retrospective_event_study.use: association/context only; do not supply this study as admissible predictive factor or promote from its results
